inputs.name: india_vix
inputs.label: India VIX
inputs.help: The market's expected volatility over the next 30 days (index points)

inputs.name: vix_vs_avg_pct
inputs.label: VIX vs its 60-day average (%)
inputs.help: Positive means fear is higher than it has been recently

inputs.name: vix_change_5d_pct
inputs.label: VIX change over 5 days (%)
inputs.help: How fast fear moved in the last week

inputs.name: drawdown_pct
inputs.label: Nifty 200 below its 1-year high (%)
inputs.help: 0 means at a 1-year high; -10 means 10% below it

inputs.name: dist_200dma_pct
inputs.label: Nifty 200 vs its 200-day average (%)
inputs.help: Positive means above the long-term average

inputs.name: ma50_vs_ma200_pct
inputs.label: 50-day vs 200-day average (%)
inputs.help: Positive means the medium-term average is above the long-term one

inputs.name: return_5d_pct
inputs.label: Nifty 200 5-day return (%)
inputs.help: Index change over the last 5 trading days
